report.summary: The only failure is test_invalid_book_is_rejected[blank-title], which expects a whitespace-only title to get 422 but gets 201. The app is doing this because the seeded blank_title bug is active: validate_book skips the blank-title check whenever "blank_title" is in BUGS. Fix the product code (or the BUGS setting in the CI environment, if the bug should not be on for this run) before touching the test.

causes.title: Whitespace-only book titles are accepted by POST /api/books
causes.explanation: validate_book only rejects a blank title when the seeded bug is off: the condition is `not book.title.strip() and "blank_title" not in BUGS`. With BUGS containing blank_title, a title of "   " passes validation and the book is inserted, so the API returns 201 where the test expects 422. The test's expectation matches the documented rule ("Title must not be blank") and the other three parametrized cases in the same test are not affected. The failure is deterministic, not timing-related.
evidence: app/main.py:86: if not book.title.strip() and "blank_title" not in BUGS:
app/main.py:10: blank_title      accepts a title made only of spaces (module docstring)
app/main.py:31: BUGS = {b.strip() for b in os.environ.get("BUGS", "").split(",") if b.strip()}
Test parameter: ({"title": "   ", "author": "A"}, "Title must not be blank") in tests/api/test_books_api.py:56
causes.suggested_fix: Fix validate_book in app/main.py:86 so a whitespace-only title is always rejected. If blank_title is a deliberately seeded defect that should stay on, then this test is expected to fail in that configuration: mark it xfail for that BUGS setting, or run the suite with BUGS unset for the regular build. Do not weaken the assertion to accept 201. The repo does not show where BUGS is set for CI, so I could not confirm the environment; the 201 response itself shows the bug is active in this run.
